title: Refuse close on a capped cell with no leader check
action: Add the leader-check door to build_close_report_doors and its refusal arm, per D6a's two orders. PUSH the Door at the slot after dissent-debt (close.rs:1671) and before advisor-nudge-debt (close.rs:1726). Place the REFUSAL ARM last among the cell-debt arms: after the mistakes arm (close.rs:2655) and before the uat arm (close.rs:2685), so the specific debts surface first and this broad one masks none of them. Door detail and refusal copy the three-line shape verbatim from the judge-debt arm (close.rs:2550): headline naming the feature and the offending ids, a 'remedy:' line naming bee cells leader-check plus the leader-check-deferral escape (and bee cells unarchive FIRST when any offender resolves only under the archive, the hpf-1 shape at close.rs:1586-1592), and a 'next:' line. The remedy also names bee cells reopen as the road when a recorded gap needs rework. The debt count and the escape are read from verbs/cells/leader_check.rs — feature_leader_check_debt and has_leader_check_deferral_decision — never re-implemented here, the same way close.rs:1654 reads dissent's. Add a blocking_doors/merge_ready row for the new door name wherever the existing doors are enumerated.
